visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a person's hands with painted nails slicing a green zucchini on a grey cutting board in a well-lit kitchen. A middle-aged woman in a plaid shirt is then shown slicing the vegetable, followed by her holding a white bowl of cooked meat and speaking directly to the camera with an animated expression. (2) Transitions to an indoor setting where hands are seen neatly folding a black pleated garment on a white surface. The middle-aged woman then excitedly holds up a white sleeveless top in front of a wardrobe, smiling and gesturing. Later, she is shown lying on a brown sofa under a striped blanket, sleeping while holding her phone, before waking up. (3) The scene shifts to the woman and a younger female in a striped shirt singing karaoke together in a living room, both looking very happy. They are then shown at a dining table, eating meat and fruit with their hands. The older woman is then seen looking into a white circular mirror, examining her face and forehead wrinkles with a concerned expression. (4) A vibrant montage showcases various LEGO Botanical and Art sets, including roses, orchids, and sunflowers, with official logos and product numbers displayed as text. The two women are then seen holding the LEGO boxes and completed models, presenting them enthusiastically to the camera in a bright indoor environment while gesturing toward the details. (5) The women sit together on a sofa, focused on assembling the colorful LEGO pieces according to a manual. After finishing, they stand behind a table full of their completed LEGO floral and art creations, cheering and celebrating. The video ends with a humorous moment where the younger woman gives the older woman a tight, somewhat awkward hug.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A youthful male narrator begins with a friendly, conversational tone over a bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop BGM. Rhythmic thudding SFX of a knife slicing vegetables is heard. The middle-aged female voice then breaks in with a loud, authoritative, yet playful tone in Taiwanese Mandarin, followed by more narration and the soft rustling sound of clothing. (2) The audio features a high-pitched, excited exclamation from the female character, followed by a humorous snoring SFX and a surprised vocal stinger. Later, high-energy singing by two females dominates the track over karaoke-style synthesized beats. Distinct percussive squelching SFX are heard during an eating segment, emphasizing the texture of the food being consumed. (3) The female voice shifts to a somber, lower pitch and slower tempo as she expresses concern about aging. The narrator then adopts a more energetic, promotional tone, clearly enunciating product names and numbers. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat rhythm with guitar and electronic textures throughout this segment, creating a positive and informative atmosphere. (4) A sharp 'tape rewind' SFX transition leads into the distinct, crisp clicking sounds of plastic LEGO bricks being snapped together. Casual, fast-paced dialogue between the two women fills the space, characterized by frequent laughter, teasing inflections, and high vocal arousal. The clicking SFX continues as a rhythmic background element to their conversation. (5) The audio reaches a peak with loud, synchronized cheering and a high-intensity vocal celebration upon completing the Lego build. The BGM swells for a celebratory finish before ending. A final comic impact or groaning SFX punctuates the younger woman's hug, providing a humorous and slightly chaotic resolution to the audio narrative.
